Survey statement (Hindi): बुद्धि विहार में पाइपलाइन के लिए खुदी सड़कें अभी तक उखड़ी पड़ी हैं
Voter says (English): Roads in Buddhi Vihar dug for pipelines are still broken
Basis: Amar Ujala (15 Sep 2026): roads dug up by the Jal Nigam team for pipelines left unrepaired in several places, from Sector 4 to Sector 9; Sector 9B road left incomplete for four months; Awas Vikas and Nagar Nigam have not fixed responsibility for repair. Amar Ujala (17 Sep 2026) repeats that roads from Sector 4 to 9 are still dug up. AC membership: Buddhi Vihar is named inside the Moradabad Nagar seat section of Amar Ujala (20 Apr 2024), location evidence only.

Survey statement (Hindi): सीतापुरी दस सराय में गंदा नाला जाम है, पांच हजार लोग परेशान हैं
Voter says (English): In Sitapuri Das Sarai the dirty drain is choked, and 5,000 people are troubled
Basis: Amar Ujala (7 Jun 2026): drain between Sitapuri Das Sarai and Chau ki Basti choked; the article says 5,000 people of three settlements suffer; residents say the Nagar Nigam made no drainage plan despite a CM portal complaint. AC membership: Das Sarai is named as a Nagar mandal in the BJP mandal report (Amrit Vichar, 31 Dec 2024); the drain article itself does not name the seat, so this is mandal-level evidence.

Survey statement (Hindi): जिला अस्पताल में डॉक्टर की लिखी कुछ दवाएं नहीं मिलतीं
Voter says (English): Some medicines prescribed by the doctor are not available at the district hospital
Basis: Amar Ujala (24 Dec 2025): at the district hospital, cough syrup, a pain tablet, diclofenac gel, a piles medicine and some eye drops were not available to patients. District-level hospital report, not specific to this AC.

Survey statement (Hindi): शहर में जाम आम बात है, दिनभर गाड़ियों का भारी दबाव रहता है
Voter says (English): Jams are common in the city, with heavy vehicle pressure all day
Basis: Royal Bulletin (6 Oct 2026): the new SP Traffic says reducing city jams is the focus; places where vehicle pressure stays high through the day and jams recur are being identified. This is an official statement, no roads named. City-level, not a named AC location.

Survey statement (Hindi): 3 करोड़ 65 लाख के सड़क और नाले के काम शुरू हो गए
Voter says (English): Road and drain works worth Rs 3 crore 65 lakh have started
Basis: Verified: MLA Ramveer Singh performed bhoomi pujan and shilanyas for works totalling Rs 3 crore 65 lakh on Monday 8 June 2026 (article dated 9 June 2026): Banhpur village road Rs 61.21 lakh, Masebi Rasulpur to Taharpur Doyam and Basera Khas link road Rs 74.97 lakh, Moradabad-Ganwa-Bulandshahr road km 1-10 drain and special repair Rs 229.40 lakh. Article says construction was formally started and gives no completion date. Village membership in the AC is not separately confirmed; works are attributed to the MLA of Kundarki.

Survey statement (Hindi): बिना पंजीकरण चल रहे क्लीनिक और लैब पर सील लगी
Voter says (English): Clinics and a pathology lab running without registration were sealed
Basis: Verified: health team led by Kundarki CHC Chief Medical Superintendent Dr Saurabh Bartariya sealed four facilities (article dated 17 Sep 2026): two unregistered clinics at Mohanpur village crossroads, one maternity centre in Kundarki town, and one pathology lab in Dingarpur village. Operators could not show valid papers. Official enforcement; no resident reaction is reported. Mohanpur and Dingarpur AC membership not confirmed (Kundarki town facility is in the AC by name).

Survey statement (Hindi): *हाईटेंशन लाइन की टहनियां कटीं, अब तार टूटने का खतरा कम है
Voter says (English): *Branches were cut from the high-tension line, so the risk of a wire breakdown is now lower
Basis: Inference: the 4 Oct 2026 Amar Ujala article reports that during the 3 Oct maintenance outage (about five and a half hours) tree branches near the 132 kV line were trimmed to prevent a breakdown in storms. Junior engineer Jayveer Singh says breakdown risk has greatly reduced. This is an official claim; no source records voters appreciating it. Line membership in the AC not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): *कुंदरकी नगर के वार्ड 8 में पीएम श्री कंपोजिट स्कूल चल रहा है
Voter says (English): *A PM SHRI composite school runs in Ward 8 of Kundarki nagar panchayat
Basis: Inference: the 17 Jul 2026 Amar Ujala article (verified) names the PM SHRI Composite School among the landmarks of Ward 8, Nagar Panchayat Kundarki. The article does not report on the school's quality; no source shows residents praising it. Listed only as an existing public facility.

Survey statement (Hindi): *कुंदरकी सीएचसी में ओपीडी चलती है और दवा मिल जाती है
Voter says (English): *OPD runs at Kundarki CHC and medicines are available
Basis: Inference: the 8 Sep 2026 Amar Ujala article (verified) reports officials saying adequate medicine is available at the CHC and all PHCs and doctors hold OPD on time. This is an official claim, not resident praise, and the same article reports serious gaps (see negatives).

Survey statement (Hindi): वार्ड 8 में चार साल से टंकी में दूषित पानी, पीने लायक नहीं
Voter says (English): In Ward 8, for four years the household tanks have had contaminated water, not fit to drink
Basis: Verified (article dated 17 Jul 2026): Ward 8 of Nagar Panchayat Kundarki, over 5,000 residents; main problem is contaminated supply reaching household tanks for four years; residents say officials' assurances have not solved it. No official action is quoted.

Survey statement (Hindi): सीएचसी पर एक्स-रे टेक्नीशियन नहीं था, दो साल से आंख का डॉक्टर नहीं
Voter says (English): At the CHC the X-ray technician was not there, and no eye doctor for two years
Basis: Verified: Kundarki CHC (article dated 8 Sep 2026): the X-ray technician was posted to Bilari CHC for three days of duty, so no X-ray that Monday; the CHC has had no eye specialist for two years, the previous one transferred to Sambhal; specialist doctor, pharmacist and health worker posts vacant. Officials say a letter requesting an eye specialist was already sent to senior officers. Patients appeared distressed (headline).

Survey statement (Hindi): वार्ड नौ में नल का प्रेशर कम, हैंडपंप से गंदा पानी आता है
Voter says (English): Tap water pressure is weak in ward nine, and handpump water is dirty
Basis: Verified (Ward 9 of Nagar Panchayat Kundarki, article dated 18 Jul 2026): supply in most homes arrives at low pressure so chores go unfinished and supply cuts out; handpumps give dirty water; lanes are narrow and pothole-filled. No response from officials or the nagar panchayat is reported.

Survey statement (Hindi): कुंदरकी-हरियाणा संपर्क मार्ग पर बारिश में पानी-कीचड़, गड्ढों में गिरकर चोट लगती है
Voter says (English): On the Kundarki-Haryana link road, rain brings water and mud, and falling into potholes causes injuries
Basis: Verified (article dated 26 Aug 2026): poor drainage causes waterlogging and mud, deep potholes, bike riders fall and get hurt, farmers wade through dirty water. The article says the road links 12 villages to Kundarki town and names 10 of them (plus Haryana as the far end). A nagar panchayat councillor (Nazim Usmani) says PWD was asked to build the road and no action has been taken. AC MEMBERSHIP UNCONFIRMED: no source places these villages in the Kundarki AC, so this item is not counted in ac_specific_negatives.

Survey statement (Hindi): बिजलीघर में पानी भरता है, दीवार का हिस्सा टूटा, ट्रांसफार्मर खतरे में
Voter says (English): The power station yard fills with water, part of the wall has broken, and transformers are at risk
Basis: Verified (Kundarki power station, article dated 28 Aug 2026): yard sits lower than the ground around it so rain stays; water collects at the SDO office, JE office and cash counter entrances; one side of the boundary wall collapsed and is not rebuilt, so high-capacity transformers in the yard are at risk. SDO Satish Kumar says a permanent fix is possible only after the rains end. Power station is in Kundarki town, the seat's namesake.

Survey statement (Hindi): मिल मालिक पर गन्ना बकाये का मुकदमा दर्ज हुआ, कार्रवाई तो हुई
Voter says (English): A case was registered against the mill owner over cane dues, so at least some action was taken
Basis: Police case registered at Bilari police station against the owner of the Ayudhya sugar mill, Bilari, and two others over unpaid cane dues (Patrika, 4 Sep 2025). Weak positive: this is a case, not a payment; dues of Rs 39.91 crore were still outstanding in that report.

Survey statement (Hindi): डीएम के दबाव से मिल ने 3 करोड़ रुपये दिए, कुछ तो मिला
Voter says (English): After DM pressure, the mill paid Rs 3 crore, so at least something came
Basis: Bilari sugar mill paid Rs 3 crore after strong pressure from the District Magistrate; about Rs 18.92 crore still remained after that payment (Amar Ujala, Moradabad, 30 Oct 2024). Weak positive: partial payment, 2024, and the current status was not found.

Survey statement (Hindi): भूमिगत पाइपलाइन तो बिछ गई, बस टंकी बाकी है
Voter says (English): At least the underground pipelines are laid, only the tank is still pending
Basis: Villagers of Sherpur Maafi, Bilari block, said underground water pipelines were laid about two years ago, but no water tank has been built yet (Amar Ujala, Bilari dateline, 13 Jun 2026). Weak positive: the work is partly done and the source is a complaint. AC membership of Sherpur Maafi village unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): *राशन में मुफ्त अनाज मिल रहा है
Voter says (English): *Free ration grain is being received
Basis: Inference: no Bilari-specific source found in searches; free ration (PMGKAY) is a central scheme running in UP. Not verified for Bilari.

Survey statement (Hindi): *कुछ घरों को उज्ज्वला गैस कनेक्शन मिला है
Voter says (English): *Some households got Ujjwala gas connections
Basis: Inference: no Bilari-specific source found; a general UP-wide scheme assumed to reach some Bilari households. Not verified.

Survey statement (Hindi): वीरनगर में लटके तारों से जान गई, पार्षद बोले बिजली विभाग लापरवाह है
Voter says (English): In Veer Nagar a life was lost to hanging wires, councillors say the power department is negligent
Basis: Young qawwal Babbu (Bablu) Masoodi died from touching low-hanging live wires at an empty plot in Veer Nagar mohalla, Bilari, on a Friday night. Councillors blamed the electricity department's gross negligence and residents protested (Amar Ujala, Bilari dateline, 11 Oct 2026). Allegation by councillors and residents.

Survey statement (Hindi): चीनी मिल पर किसानों का 33 से 40 करोड़ बकाया है
Voter says (English): The sugar mill still owes farmers between 33 and 40 crore rupees in cane dues
Basis: Ayudhya sugar mill, Bilari: Rs 39.91 crore 'still due' as of 2 Sep 2025 per Patrika (4 Sep 2025); Amar Ujala (1 Oct 2025) gave the dues owed to cane farmers linked to the Bilari cooperative cane committee as Rs 33 crore. Figures differ by source; current status not found.

Survey statement (Hindi): चार दिन बिजली नहीं आई, किसानों ने बिजलीघर पर प्रदर्शन किया
Voter says (English): Feeder had no power for four days, farmers protested at the power house
Basis: Bilari Dehat power house on Station Road, Bilari: burned-out tripping coil and storm-damaged poles left the East rural feeder without supply for four days; farmers with tubewells protested at the power house and SDO office and submitted a memorandum (Amar Ujala, Bilari dateline, 23 Apr 2026). Feeder villages named in the report (Mundiya Raja, Gwarkhera, Milak Nagaliya, Harora, Roja, Dharmpur Kalan) not separately confirmed as inside the AC.

Survey statement (Hindi): नई कॉलोनी की कई गलियों में पक्की सड़क नहीं बनी है
Voter says (English): In the new colony, several lanes still have no paved road
Basis: Ward 25 of Bilari Nagar Palika Parishad: several streets in a newly developed colony lack paved roads. The municipal road from Paint Bazaar via Sarkari Hospital Road to Shahabad Road is broken in places; tender completed but construction not started. Residents say the low PWD Shahabad Road floods in rain (Amar Ujala, 2 Aug 2026). MLA of Bilari constituency also raised broken roads in the rains (Amar Ujala, 6 Aug 2026).

Survey statement (Hindi): बारिश में नई सड़क और शाहबाद रोड पर पानी भर जाता है
Voter says (English): When it rains, water collects on the new road and Shahabad Road
Basis: Bilari town: continuous rain from 26 Sep 2026 caused waterlogging on Naya Sadak, Purana Dakhana Road and Shahabad Road, causing difficulty for pedestrians and drivers (Amar Ujala, Bilari dateline, 27 Sep 2026).

Survey statement (Hindi): चंदौसी चौराहे का चौड़ीकरण शुरू हो गया है
Voter says (English): Work to widen the Chandausi crossing has started
Basis: ETV Bharat Hindi (6 Oct 2026): widening and beautification work began on Tuesday around 9 am at the Chandausi crossing; first step took about 2.5 hours; electricity dept shifted two poles; PWD, electricity dept and Nagar Palika coordinating. Amar Ujala (7 Oct 2026, Sambhal dateline): Rs 62 lakh sanctioned for the widening; encroachments cleared on 6 Oct; roundabout planned at centre; SDM directed PWD XEN to start work soon, so the start is reported by ETV only.

Survey statement (Hindi): शहर में चार जगह वॉटर हार्वेस्टिंग सिस्टम लग गए हैं
Voter says (English): Four rainwater harvesting systems have been put up at places in the town
Basis: Amar Ujala (11 Aug 2026, Chandausi dateline): Chandausi EO Satyendra Prakash said the municipality has installed four water-harvesting systems and is working on the waterlogging problem; the same report says the civic body blames old drainage and silt.

Survey statement (Hindi): बारिश से पहले नालों की सफाई तो हुई थी
Voter says (English): Drains were cleaned before the rains, that much was done
Basis: Amar Ujala (11 Aug 2026, Chandausi): EO said drains were cleaned before the rains, but encroachment made cleaning difficult in some places and some drains are narrow. This is the municipality's own claim, reported in the same article that describes flooding.

Survey statement (Hindi): सड़क से अतिक्रमण हटा, यह अच्छा हुआ
Voter says (English): It was good that encroachment was cleared from the road
Basis: Organiser (15 Jan 2026): drive on 14 Jan 2026 reclaimed nearly 19 bighas (1.239 hectares) of public land on Chandausi Road; local residents welcomed it as improving traffic flow; affected families raised rehabilitation gaps. The article places the road in Sambhal tehsil, so AC membership unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): संभल और चंदौसी की 66 परियोजनाओं का लोकार्पण हुआ
Voter says (English): 66 projects in Sambhal and Chandausi were inaugurated
Basis: ETV Bharat Hindi (18 Jul 2026): CM Yogi Adityanath inaugurated and laid foundation stones for 66 projects worth Rs 569 crore for Sambhal and Chandausi constituencies combined; the article names no Chandausi-only project and gives no separate Chandausi figure. Weak candidate, kept only as the last positive.

Survey statement (Hindi): चंद मिनट की बारिश में मुख्य सड़कें डूब जाती हैं
Voter says (English): Main roads turn into waterlogged streets after just a few minutes of rain
Basis: Amar Ujala (11 Aug 2026, Chandausi): main roads, Railway Station Road and Sabzi Mandi flood after a few minutes of rain; spots named include Fuwara Chowk, Sita Ashram Road, Ganesh Colony, Sambhal Gate, Golaganj, Salim ki Puliya and Hanumangarhi; water takes 3-4 hours to recede; report says drains built for crores failed to stop waterlogging; EO blames encroachment on drains.

Survey statement (Hindi): बिजली गई तो पानी भी बंद हो जाता है
Voter says (English): When power goes, water supply stops too
Basis: Amar Ujala (27 Sep 2026, Chandausi dateline): on 26 Sep rain flooded main roads and power was cut around 9 am, restored around 6 pm; about 1,000 residents in Shaktinagar, Station Road and Awas Vikas were left without electricity and water; municipal pipeline water comes only morning and evening.

Survey statement (Hindi): रेलवे फाटक और बड़ा बाजार चौराहे पर रोज़ जाम लगता है
Voter says (English): Jams at the railway gate and Bada Bazaar happen every day
Basis: Amar Ujala (20 Apr 2026, Chandausi): jams at the railway crossing near the Kabristan last for hours; other spots named include Bada Bazaar chauraha, Rambagh Road, Kaithal Gate culvert, Saraafa and Pasrattaa bazaars and Husaini and Lakshmi bazaars; causes named: two-wheelers parked before shops, carts at intersections, e-rickshaws in markets and encroachment returning after last year's drive; traffic SI Dushyant Baliyan said staff were withdrawn from Chandausi markets.

Survey statement (Hindi): स्टेशन का फुट ओवरब्रिज छह महीने से अधूरा पड़ा था
Voter says (English): The station's foot overbridge had been lying unfinished for six months
Basis: Amar Ujala (25 Feb 2026, Chandausi): 12-metre-wide foot overbridge sections (about Rs 3.25 crore, made at Lucknow workshop) have lain at Chandausi station for six months without being joined under the Amrit Bharat station scheme; no completion date given, railway ADEN says soon. Station upgrade promised within one year is more than two years late. Status after Feb 2026 not checked.

Survey statement (Hindi): बाहर बीस रुपये का कैनुला अस्पताल में 234 रुपये का मिलता है
Voter says (English): A cannula costs Rs 20 outside but Rs 234 at the hospital
Basis: Amar Ujala (9 Oct 2026, Sambhal/Chandausi dateline): district-level, not Chandausi-specific (Sambhal city hospital). Cannula about Rs 20 outside vs Rs 234 at hospital pharmacy; antibiotic injection Rs 200 vs Rs 882; outside shops offer 20-30 percent discounts. Complainant Asim of Sirsi village.

Survey statement (Hindi): कानून व्यवस्था पहले से बेहतर है
Voter says (English): Law and order has improved compared to earlier
Basis: Amar Ujala Asmoli constituency report (4 Sep 2026): several residents said law and order has improved; Nasir Hussain and Jamshed Ansari praised it

Survey statement (Hindi): बिजली पहले से ठीक मिलने लगी है
Voter says (English): Electricity has started to come in better than before
Basis: Amar Ujala Asmoli constituency report (4 Sep 2026): one resident (Nasir) said electricity has improved since the BJP came to power; only one resident raised it

Survey statement (Hindi): खेमपुर-भैंसोड़ा सड़क बनने का काम शुरू हुआ है
Voter says (English): Work has started on the Khempur-Bhainsora road
Basis: India Daily (page updated 23 Jun 2026): 2.5 km road costing Rs 153.55 lakh, funded from MLC funds, work launched, ~30 villages, expected in six months, status ongoing and not finished; villagers said the route was nearly impassable in rain; Asmoli block named, Asmoli AC membership unconfirmed

Survey statement (Hindi): सरकार का काम ठीक चल रहा है
Voter says (English): The government's work is going well
Basis: Amar Ujala Asmoli constituency report (4 Sep 2026): Shakil Ahmed said the government is working well and all work is being done properly; Anil Kumar Sharma said governance is good

Survey statement (Hindi): *संभल में कई विकास कार्यों के लोकार्पण की योजना है
Voter says (English): Inference: a programme to inaugurate many development works in Sambhal district is planned
Basis: Inference: Patrika (6 Aug 2025) reported a planned programme of 221 works in Sambhal district (108 foundation stones, 113 inaugurations, Rs 546.25 crore); a planned programme, not confirmed delivered, district-level, does not name Asmoli

Survey statement (Hindi): अलीगढ़-मुरादाबाद हाईवे से 14 गांवों के घर और स्कूल उजड़ने का डर
Voter says (English): Fear of losing homes and schools in 14 villages due to the Aligarh-Moradabad highway route
Basis: Amar Ujala (9 Oct 2026): MLA Pinki Yadav and MP Dharmendra Yadav met Gadkari; the article names 14 villages of Asmoli assembly constituency (and 10 of Gunnaur) where homes, businesses and schools face displacement; they asked for a route change and market-value land purchase instead of circle rates

Survey statement (Hindi): असमोली सीएचसी में डॉक्टर कम हैं, बाहर जाना पड़ता है
Voter says (English): Asmoli CHC has too few doctors; patients have to go elsewhere for treatment
Basis: Amar Ujala (19 Aug 2026): Asmoli CHC has 3 MBBS doctors and no specialists against 8 needed (6 specialists); serves 100+ villages; patients pay private hospitals or are referred to district hospital; no eye surgeon or delivery surgeon. Article names Asmoli CHC and Sambhal, not the constituency; AC membership unconfirmed (CHC is in Asmoli town, the AC's namesake)

Survey statement (Hindi): गांव की सड़कें बहुत खराब हैं
Voter says (English): Village roads are in very poor condition
Basis: Amar Ujala Asmoli constituency report (4 Sep 2026): Hussain and Yakub said village roads are in poor condition; Yakub called roads the biggest issue; Pawan Kumar said roads need to be built; no village named

Survey statement (Hindi): चीनी के दाम बढ़े पर गन्ने का दाम नहीं बढ़ा
Voter says (English): Sugar prices went up but sugarcane price did not rise
Basis: Amar Ujala Asmoli constituency report (4 Sep 2026): Anil Kumar Sharma said sugar prices have risen but cane prices have not; farmers' statement; no mill or dues figure given

Survey statement (Hindi): हमारे इलाके में शिक्षा पर कोई ठोस कदम नहीं उठे
Voter says (English): No concrete steps have been taken on education in our area
Basis: Amar Ujala Asmoli constituency report (4 Sep 2026): Deepak said no concrete steps have been taken on education locally; Sumit Rawat urged parents to use government schools

Survey statement (Hindi): शहर में सड़कों और नालों का 10 करोड़ का काम शुरू हुआ है
Voter says (English): Work worth Rs 10 crore on city roads and drains has started
Basis: Amar Ujala (4 Aug 2026): a Rs 10 crore project for city roads, drains and sewers has started; construction has begun on Bhure Shah Road (Rs 36 lakh), Hauz Bhaddesarai (Rs 21 lakh) and Hatimsarai (Rs 39 lakh); a Rs 9 crore tender for the remaining work is under way; the work will cover 137 places; contracted firms must finish in 2-3 months. Started, not completed.

Survey statement (Hindi): शहर में नई पाइपलाइन और टंकी का काम कुछ मोहल्लों में शुरू हुआ
Voter says (English): Work on new water pipelines and an overhead tank has started in some city mohallas
Basis: Amar Ujala (20 Jun 2026): Jal Nigam has started work worth Rs 170 crore under the drinking water scheme; a 268 km pipeline line will be laid in all 37 wards; an overhead tank construction has begun in Begum Sarai and pipe laying is under way in Shahzadi Sarai. Started, not delivered.

Survey statement (Hindi): सड़कों के गड्ढे भरने का काम शुरू हो गया है
Voter says (English): Work to fill potholes on the roads has started
Basis: District-level, AC membership unconfirmed: Amar Ujala (30 Sep 2026) reports PWD pothole filling has started at village Janeta on the Sambhal-Chandausi road and at Khirni on the Sambhal-Gawan road; XEN PWD Sunil Prakash said the work will be completed within a month. Started, not yet finished.

Survey statement (Hindi): जिला पंचायत का नया कार्यालय भवन बनकर तैयार हो गया
Voter says (English): The new district panchayat office building has been completed
Basis: District-level, AC membership unconfirmed: Amar Ujala (8 Jul 2026), datelined Bahjoi, reports a Rs 7.23 crore district panchayat office building on Sambhal Road near Bahpurpatti village was completed in 18 months and inaugurated by the district in-charge minister, JPS Rathore. Weakest positive: a government building, not a direct service.

Survey statement (Hindi): सफाई निरीक्षक कहते हैं, 75 फीसदी नाले साफ हो गए
Voter says (English): The sanitation inspector says about 75 percent of the drains have been cleaned
Basis: Amar Ujala (6 Jul 2026): sanitation inspector Asif says about 75% of the drains have been cleaned; Rs 33 lakh spent, yet the article says drains could not be properly cleaned. Residents disagree: a Halluserai resident (Shakeel) says regular cleaning never happened; a Dehli Darwaza resident (Mohammad Faim) says the drain is never properly cleaned. This is an official claim that residents dispute, so it is a weak positive.

Survey statement (Hindi): एक घंटे की बारिश में शंकर चौराहा रोडवेज बस स्टैंड डूब जाते हैं
Voter says (English): Just an hour of rain floods Shankar Chauraha and the roadways bus stand
Basis: Amar Ujala Sambhal (3 Aug 2026): about one hour of heavy rain on Sunday afternoon caused waterlogging at Shankar Chauraha, Hospital Chauraha, the Roadways bus stand, the district hospital premises, Yashoda Market, Dehli Darwaza, Bhure Shah Road and Hatimsarai; the EO, Aditya Prakash, said pumps are used where there is no drainage and that most drains are to be rebuilt. A second report (Amar Ujala, 12 Aug 2026) says 2-3 feet of waterlogging was seen on roads from the Chandausi crossing toward the government hospital and at Shankar Chauraha after rain on Tuesday morning.

Survey statement (Hindi): नाले कभी साफ नहीं होते, कूड़े से अटे पड़े हैं
Voter says (English): Drains are never cleaned, they are choked with garbage
Basis: Amar Ujala Sambhal (7 Jun 2026): drains are blocked with garbage at Halloo Sarai, near Azad Girls Inter College, Dehli Darwaza and near Manokamna Mandir; drains at Hasanpur Marg, Bhure Shah Road and Nai Sarai are reported as not cleaned; residents say accident fears rise when drains overflow in rain; Sarai Tarin trader Neeraj Bajaj says the whole road waterlogs in rain. Amar Ujala (6 Jul 2026) quotes a Dehli Darwaza resident, Mohammad Faim: 'नाला कभी साफ ही नहीं होता'.

Survey statement (Hindi): जिला अस्पताल में डॉक्टरों की कमी है, मुरादाबाद जाना पड़ता है
Voter says (English): The district hospital is short of doctors, so we have to go to Moradabad for treatment
Basis: Amar Ujala Sambhal (11 Aug 2026): the district hospital has 10 of 23 sanctioned posts filled; specialists are missing; the CMS post is vacant; the DM wrote to the state on 27 July. Patients must go about 35 km to Moradabad for the divisional hospital. The district hospital is in Sambhal city per Amar Ujala Sambhal's city reporting (3 Aug 2026 report lists the district hospital premises among city waterlogging spots); AC membership is inferred from that, not from an official extent list.

Survey statement (Hindi): गन्ने का बकाया भुगतान नहीं मिला, ब्याज का हिसाब भी नहीं
Voter says (English): Sugarcane dues are still unpaid, and farmers have not been given the interest breakdown
Basis: District-level, AC membership unconfirmed: Amar Ujala Sambhal (25 Aug 2026): a Rashtriya Kisan Mazdoor Sangathan sit-in outside the District Cane Officer's office in Sambhal was on its fifth day, demanding a full account of interest on pending cane payments; farmers said they have not received the money, and that the mill had said it would give cheques but the money did not reach their accounts; DCO Dhaniram said the interest calculation is being prepared and will take some time. The outcome after 25 Aug was not found. This is the original report behind the ChiniMandi item.

Survey statement (Hindi): संभल में रेल नेटवर्क कमजोर है, गजरौला वाली लाइन अब तक नहीं बनी
Voter says (English): Sambhal has a weak rail network, and the Sambhal-Gajraula line is still not built
Basis: District-level, not AC-specific: Patrika (4 Apr 2026) reports MP Ziaur Rahman Barq met Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw and sought quick approval of the Sambhal-Gajraula line extension, and proposed a new line from Sambhal, Chandausi and Budaun to Delhi; the article says no concrete step has been taken, and the only service is a two-coach demo train from Hatim Sarai to Bilari, Raja ka Sahaspur and Moradabad, twice a day, with freight discontinued.

Survey statement (Hindi): स्वार सीएचसी पर हार्ट अटैक का जीवनरक्षक इंजेक्शन मिलने लगा है
Voter says (English): The life-saving heart attack injection is now available at Swar CHC
Basis: Amar Ujala 30 Aug 2026 (Rampur dateline): five tenecteplase injections kept at each of five CHCs (Swar, Bilaspur, Shahabad, Milak, Tanda) for emergencies; CMO Dr Deepa Singh says timely treatment is meant for the golden hour; Meerut expert team decides on use after ECG

Survey statement (Hindi): स्वार की सात सड़कों के लिए 7.9 करोड़ रुपये मंजूर हुए हैं
Voter says (English): Rs 7.9 crore has been sanctioned for seven roads in Swar
Basis: Amar Ujala 4 Apr 2026 (Swar dateline): about Rs 7.9 crore approved for seven works in Swar constituency, via PWD under the Economic Development Scheme; MLA Shafiq Ahmad Ansari confirms the sanction; article says work will start soon, not begun. Approval stage only, not a completed or started project

Survey statement (Hindi): 10 घंटे बाद बिजली आई, चलो राहत मिली
Voter says (English): Power came back after ten hours, and that was a relief
Basis: Amar Ujala 20 Aug 2026 (Swar dateline): 33 kV line fault from Tanda repaired and Swar town supply fully restored around 11:30 AM Wednesday; article says people breathed a sigh of relief when power returned. Restoration of a fault, not a new supply

Survey statement (Hindi): आयुष्मान कार्ड बनने से मरीजों को इलाज का सहारा मिल रहा है
Voter says (English): Ayushman cards being made are giving patients support for treatment
Basis: District-level, not AC-specific: Mediasaheb 11 Oct 2026: 1,79,000 Ayushman cards made in past year, 6,91,928 in total, Rampur ranked first in UP per the report; Swar and Tanda tehsil beneficiaries named, no AC card count given

Survey statement (Hindi): *सड़कें बनीं तो गांवों का आना-जाना आसान होगा
Voter says (English): Inference: If the roads are built, travel between villages will become easier
Basis: Inference: no completed road or other delivered project in Swar was found in sources; this rests on the sanctioned seven-road budget (rank 2), which has not started. Forecast, not appreciation; flagged for field check

Survey statement (Hindi): गांवों में लगातार बिजली कटौती से किसान और व्यापारी परेशान हैं
Voter says (English): Constant power cuts in villages hurt farmers and traders
Basis: Amar Ujala 20 Sep 2026 (Moradabad bureau, Swar tehsil): BKU Lok Shakti dharna at Swar tehsil power house; memorandum to JE (Rural) Shyam Singh; demands at least 18 hours rural supply, new independent substation for Khempur and Narpatnagar, connecting Rajnagar and Pusvada feeders to Swar rural substation, survey of overloaded feeders. Quote: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में लगातार बिजली कटौती से किसान, व्यापारी, विद्यार्थी और आम उपभोक्ता परेशान हैं. AC membership unconfirmed for rural feeders, Khempur and Narpatnagar (Narpatnagar is a nagar panchayat not in the AC extent); not counted in ac_specific_negatives

Survey statement (Hindi): स्वार में बिजली की लाइन बार-बार खराब हुई, दस घंटे बत्ती गुल रही
Voter says (English): The power line kept breaking down in Swar, and the lights were out for ten hours
Basis: Amar Ujala 20 Aug 2026 (Swar dateline): 33 kV line from Tanda faulted; Swar town and nearby areas without power about ten hours; SDO Hari Deepak Yadav cites continuous overnight breakdowns; Rasulpur feeder also faulted. Swar town is in the AC (Swar MB)

Survey statement (Hindi): टांडा हुरमतनगर में कच्चे रास्ते, जलभराव और नल में पानी नहीं आता
Voter says (English): In Tanda Hurmatnagar there are unpaved lanes, waterlogging, and no water from the taps
Basis: Amar Ujala 27 Mar 2026 (Bilaspur dateline, Moradabad bureau): Ward 23 of Tanda Hurmat Nagar mohalla, about 6,000 residents; unpaved roads and rain waterlogging; pipeline laid about ten years ago has brought no water; councillor Shaheen Jahan and EO Dr Nitin Kumar Gangwar quoted. AC membership: Tanda MB is in the AC extent per Wikipedia

Survey statement (Hindi): स्वार सीएचसी की व्यवस्था से शिकायत है
Voter says (English): We have complaints about the arrangements at Swar CHC
Basis: Amar Ujala 6 Apr 2026: MLA's son Umar Ansari inspected Swar CHC after complaints about hospital arrangements and sat in the in-charge's chair; CMO Dr Deepa Singh formed an inquiry team; article reports no findings yet. Allegations only. Swar CHC is in Swar town (AC)

Survey statement (Hindi): अंडरपास का पानी निकालने से फसल खराब और बाढ़ का खतरा, आरोप है
Voter says (English): Allegedly, pumping water out of the underpass is damaging crops and raising flood risk
Basis: Amar Ujala 25 May 2026 (Kamri dateline): Swar Khurd villagers protested again at a railway underpass site; seven or eight pumps running continuously allegedly harm crops and lower well water and raise flood risk; no official response in article. AC membership unconfirmed: Swar Khurd is near Kamri, which is not in the AC extent; not counted in ac_specific_negatives

Survey statement (Hindi): खाद समय पर मिल रही है, सब्सिडी सीधे खाते में आती है
Voter says (English): Fertiliser arrives on time and subsidy goes straight to the bank account
Basis: An unnamed farmer in the Chamraua constituency said fertiliser now arrives on time and subsidy reaches farmers' accounts directly (Amar Ujala, 3 Sep 2026). Single farmer's view reported in the article.

Survey statement (Hindi): चमरौआ पॉलीटेक्निक का मुख्य भवन बन गया है
Voter says (English): The main building of the Chamraua polytechnic is complete
Basis: Polytechnic building costing Rs 8.75 crore in Chamraua, Rampur: administrative, main academic and workshop buildings complete; hostels, guard room and generator room still pending (about Rs 6 crore proposal sent). Classes to begin from the new academic session; not yet started (Amar Ujala, 6 May 2026).

Survey statement (Hindi): हमें भी सरकारी योजनाओं का लाभ मिला है
Voter says (English): We have also received benefits from government schemes
Basis: Some residents in the Chamraua constituency praised state schemes and said they had received benefits; no scheme is named (Amar Ujala, 3 Sep 2026). Weak, general positive.

Survey statement (Hindi): पीएचसी चमरौआ में जांच यूनिट का भवन लगभग बन गया है
Voter says (English): The testing unit building at PHC Chamraua is nearly complete
Basis: Block public health unit at PHC Chamraua (one of three units with CHC Milak and CHC Swar) under Ayushman Bharat infrastructure; construction described as nearly complete, planned lab, computer room and two halls, about Rs 39 lakh per unit. As of June 2025 lab technician recruitment was awaited, so this is a building, not a working service. Status may have changed since (Amar Ujala, 7 Jun 2025).

Survey statement (Hindi): चमरौआ स्टेशन पर चोरी के आरोपी चार पकड़े गए
Voter says (English): Four accused in a theft were caught at Chamraua station
Basis: GRP arrested four accused near platform one at Chamraua station on the Rampur-Rudrapur route; cash from the sale of a stolen gold necklace (sold for Rs 72,000) recovered; earrings still with an absconding accused; a fifth accused is being sought (Amar Ujala, 16 Nov 2024). Station named Chamraua, which lies in KC Chamraua per Wikipedia extent. Weak positive: partial recovery only.

Survey statement (Hindi): पिछले पांच साल में यहां कोई विकास नहीं हुआ
Voter says (English): No development has happened here in the last five years
Basis: Youths Mushahid and Zakir Ali said no development work happened in the past five years; Zahoor also said there was no development in the constituency (Amar Ujala, 3 Sep 2026). Constituency-level voter statements, no place named.

Survey statement (Hindi): बेरोजगारी और महंगाई से हम परेशान हैं
Voter says (English): We are troubled by unemployment and inflation
Basis: Article lists inflation (महंगाई) and unemployment (बेरोजगारी) as main issues for residents and for youth; not attributed to one speaker. Constituency-level, no place named (Amar Ujala, 3 Sep 2026).

Survey statement (Hindi): मोहल्ले में नालियां भरी पड़ी हैं
Voter says (English): Drains in our mohalla are overflowing
Basis: Gundu, a resident in the Chamraua constituency, complained of overflowing drains (भरी नालियों) in his locality, and said three complaints filed at the tehsil drew no official inquiry (Amar Ujala, 3 Sep 2026). Locality not named in the source.

Survey statement (Hindi): हमारे चमरौआ का नेशनल पब्लिक इंटर कॉलेज मान्यता वापस कर गया
Voter says (English): Our National Public Inter College in Chamraua gave back its recognition
Basis: National Public Inter College, Chamraua, Rampur surrendered its recognition (June 2026). District School Inspector Anjali Agarwal said it was because student numbers kept falling; the order by the council secretary covered more than 400 colleges statewide (Amar Ujala, 18 Jun 2026). No student or parent voice in the article; institutional story.

Survey statement (Hindi): सरकारी जमीन पर अवैध जुताई का आरोप है, शिकायतों पर जांच नहीं
Voter says (English): There is an allegation of illegal ploughing on government land; no inquiry into complaints
Basis: Gundu alleged illegal ploughing of government land in the Chamraua constituency and said three complaints filed at the tehsil drew no official visit or inquiry (Amar Ujala, 3 Sep 2026). Allegation by a resident, not verified by officials; land not named.

Survey statement (Hindi): गांवों की सड़कें सुधरी हैं, अब आवागमन आसान है
Voter says (English): Village roads have improved and travel is easier now
Basis: Narendra Singh says roads were once a problem but connectivity is now good. Kalpana and Ganga Mehta praise road work. No village named in the feature.

Survey statement (Hindi): बाईपास बनने से जाम से बड़ी राहत मिली है
Voter says (English): The bypass has given major relief from traffic jams
Basis: Balwinder Singh calls the bypass a big gift for solving traffic jams. No town is named. AC membership of the bypass unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): चकरोड से कब्जा हटा, किसानों को खेत तक रास्ता मिला
Voter says (English): Encroachment on a farm track was cleared, and farmers got a way to their fields
Basis: Revenue team removed years-old encroachment on a chakroad (farm access track) in Aurangnagar Khera after farmers complained to the SDM; article says farmers get relief. Dateline Bilaspur; the village's AC membership is inferred from the Bilaspur dateline, not stated.

Survey statement (Hindi): प्राथमिक स्वास्थ्य केंद्र पर अब दवा और डॉक्टर मिल रहे हैं
Voter says (English): Primary health centres now have doctors and medicines
Basis: Shyamal Mirdha says primary health centres now have enough medicines and doctors. Hamid Ali acknowledges better healthcare. PHC not named in the article.

Survey statement (Hindi): अब महिलाएं पहले से ज्यादा सुरक्षित महसूस करती हैं
Voter says (English): Women feel safer than before
Basis: Kalpana and Ganga Mehta say women feel safer than before; Vivek Agarwal says law and order has improved. Feature story, no place named.

Survey statement (Hindi): भाखड़ा डैम महीने भर से खराब, रिसाव से खेत और बंधा खतरे में
Voter says (English): Bhakra dam has been damaged for a month and keeps leaking, threatening fields and embankment
Basis: Report datelined Bilaspur (Rampur), 30 Sep 2026: dam damaged for about a month; each closure attempt fails and leakage restarts; nearby fields and embankment threatened. Dam is in Bilaspur town, inside Bilaspur Tehsil, which is in the AC (Wikipedia extent). 20 Sep report confirms the leak and a 40 m earth wall built inside the reservoir.

Survey statement (Hindi): डैम के पास सड़क सात फुट धंस गई, गड्ढों से आना-जाना मुश्किल
Voter says (English): Road near Bhakra dam sank seven feet, and the pits make travel hard
Basis: Report datelined Bilaspur (Rampur), 9 Sep 2026: road near Bhakra dam sank about seven feet and Ambedkar Park steps were damaged; residents blame continuous seepage from the reservoir. Later report (30 Sep): two large potholes on the dam road are disrupting traffic. Bilaspur town is inside the AC.

Survey statement (Hindi): रात में गांवों में एक-दो घंटे ही बिजली मिलती है
Voter says (English): Villages get power only one to two hours at night
Basis: BKU (Chaduni) workers sat in protest at the Ashoknagar substation on the Nainital highway; their memorandum says the 33 kV feeder fails at night so rural areas get 1-2 hours of power. Demand: stop night cuts. XEN assured quick resolution. Dateline Bilaspur, 16 Sep 2026. Allegation as stated by the union. Ashoknagar's AC membership not separately confirmed; Bilaspur dateline used.

Survey statement (Hindi): छोटे किसानों को पूरी खाद नहीं मिलती, कागज़ात की दिक्कत है
Voter says (English): Small farmers do not get full fertilizer allotment because of documentation issues
Basis: Farmer Niranjan Singh says small farmers often cannot get the full fertilizer quota because of incomplete registration or land records. Feature story, no village named (district-level applicability).

Survey statement (Hindi): आंधी के बाद बिलासपुर में 19 घंटे तक बिजली गुल रही
Voter says (English): Power stayed off for 19 hours in Bilaspur after a storm
Basis: District power-cut report, 2 May 2026, with a section headed 'Bilaspur: power stayed off for 19 hours'. Trees fell on the industrial line near Mullakheda; supply to dozens of villages restored Friday about 2 PM, per SDO. One-off storm outage; Mullakheda's AC membership not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): स्टेशन का काम शुरू, पानी की मशीनें और टंकियां लगीं
Voter says (English): Railway station work has started, with water machines and more tanks installed
Basis: Amar Ujala (Sambad, 10 Oct 2026): Rampur station is being modernised under Amrit Bharat, the booking window has moved to the new building, and the railway has installed chilled drinking-water machines and additional water tanks. The foot-overbridge quote is from Station Superintendent Mohammad Azam, not a voter. Amar Ujala (21 Jul 2026): foot-overbridge with lift, about Rs 23 crore under Amrit Bharat, construction started, no completion date given. It is under construction, not completed.

Survey statement (Hindi): पहले से चोरी कम हुई है, सुरक्षा बेहतर हुई है
Voter says (English): Thefts have come down and security has improved
Basis: Amar Ujala's Rampur election-issues report (2 Sep 2026, reporter Vijay Singh Pundir, states interviews are in the Rampur Vidhan Sabha constituency): an unnamed citizen said thefts had decreased and security had improved. Paraphrased, single-voice view. No independent source found.

Survey statement (Hindi): पुलिस महिलाओं की सुरक्षा पर ध्यान दे रही है
Voter says (English): Police are paying attention to women's safety
Basis: Amar Ujala's Rampur election-issues report (2 Sep 2026): an unnamed student said police were paying attention to women's safety. Paraphrased, single-voice view. No independent source found.

Survey statement (Hindi): पिछले पांच सालों में यूनिवर्सिटी और महिला सशक्तिकरण में बदलाव दिखे हैं
Voter says (English): Changes are visible over the last five years, including universities and women's empowerment
Basis: Amar Ujala's Rampur election-issues report (2 Sep 2026): unnamed students said Rampur has changed over five years, citing the establishment of universities and a push for women's empowerment. Paraphrased. Weak positive: a general view, not a named project. No independent source found.

Survey statement (Hindi): ज्वाला नगर में कुछ अच्छे बदलाव दिखे हैं
Voter says (English): Some good changes are visible in Jwala Nagar
Basis: Amar Ujala's Rampur election-issues report (2 Sep 2026): an unnamed student spoke of positive changes in Jwala Nagar, in the context of law and order and women's safety. The article gives no specifics (paraphrase). Weakest positive; single source.

Survey statement (Hindi): खुले नाले बच्चों की जान ले रहे हैं, ढक्कन अब भी नहीं लगे
Voter says (English): Open drains are taking children's lives here, and covers are still missing
Basis: Amar Ujala Rampur (Samvad, 20 Aug 2026): a child died in the drain at Nai Basti, which the article says is still uncovered. A second child, Aman of Ajitpur, died; drain covers removed with a JCB to recover his body were not put back. The article gives no ages. Mala Road drain is not fully covered, Shaukat Ali Road drain is wide and uncovered, and Swar Road drain is open. The EO said all drains had been covered but a team would be sent again. Amar Ujala (27 Sep 2026): the city has 84 drains and nallis, and blocked drains overflowed onto Shaukat Ali Road and Kachehri Road in heavy rain.

Survey statement (Hindi): रोज चार-पांच घंटे बिजली गुल रहती है, शिकायत पर ठीक जवाब नहीं मिलता
Voter says (English): Power goes off for four to five hours every day, and complaints get no proper answer
Basis: Amar Ujala Rampur (28 Feb 2026, Ramadan report): residents said power went off four to five hours a day in city areas including Pahadi Gate, Bareilly Gate in Shahabad, Civil Lines, Awas Vikas and Bilaspur Gate, and that they got no proper answer when they complained. SDO Irfan Ali blamed tree-trimming along lines; officials said Chinese manjha caught in the wires causes repeated faults, and supply would resume after repairs. Amar Ujala (27 Jul 2026) reports further outages in Qila, Shahabad Gate, Bareilly Gate and Jwala Nagar, including about two hours at Bareilly Gate and about two hours in Jwala Nagar.

Survey statement (Hindi): पाइपलाइन टूटी, दो दिन से पानी बंद और सड़कों पर पानी भरा
Voter says (English): A pipeline burst here, water was cut for two days and roads are flooded
Basis: Amar Ujala Rampur (Samvad, 30 Aug 2026): a damaged pipeline on the Kachehri Road to SBI Road route flooded roads and cut water supply for two days to the area, which the article puts at about 8,000 to 9,000 homes. Civil Lines to Gandhi Samadhi also had shortages. Repairs had not started two days after the damage was reported. EO Durgeshwar Tripathi said the damaged pipeline would be repaired. No completion is reported. Amar Ujala (22 Aug 2026): Kachehri Road, Roadways Workshop Road, Civil Lines and Jail Road were waterlogged within an hour of rain, with drain sewage on the roads.

Survey statement (Hindi): प्रतिभा है, पर यहां रोजगार के मौके सीमित हैं
Voter says (English): Youth say talent is there but job opportunities here are limited
Basis: Amar Ujala's Rampur election-issues report (2 Sep 2026), which states its interviews are in the Rampur Vidhan Sabha constituency: youth said jobs are the most important issue, that talent is not lacking but job opportunities are limited, and that Rampur, once known for factories, now lags on jobs. Reported indirectly, with no named speakers.

Survey statement (Hindi): जिला अस्पताल में वार्ड बॉय नहीं मिलते, स्ट्रेचर खुद खींचने पड़ते हैं
Voter says (English): At the district hospital, ward boys are often missing and relatives have to pull stretchers themselves
Basis: Amar Ujala (Samvad, 30 Sep 2026), Rampur district hospital: ward boys are often absent, so relatives pull stretchers and wheelchairs. Patients wait several days for ultrasound and CT tests. In a separate report the article carries, an internet failure of about three hours stopped online slip generation and long queues formed. AD Health Moradabad said relatives pulling stretchers was wrong and the CMS would be instructed to correct it. AC membership unconfirmed: the article does not state the hospital's location inside the AC, so this item is not counted in ac_specific_negatives.

Survey statement (Hindi): शिविर में आयुष्मान कार्ड और आवास की मंजूरी मिली
Voter says (English): We got Ayushman cards and Awas sanction letters at the camp
Basis: At the Seva Sankalp camp in Milak block on 27 Sep 2026, five beneficiaries got Ayushman cards and five got CM Awas Yojana (Zero Poverty) sanction letters; 493 applications under various schemes were approved that day (Amar Ujala, 28 Sep 2026). Small numbers from one camp. Milak block membership in the AC is taken from the Wikipedia extent naming Milak tehsil (Milak MB).

Survey statement (Hindi): किसान दुर्घटना योजना के पांच किसानों को चेक मिले
Voter says (English): Five farmers got cheques under the farmers accident scheme
Basis: Five eligible beneficiaries received cheques totalling Rs 5 lakh under the CM Farmers' Accident Welfare Scheme at the same Milak block camp on 27 Sep 2026 (Amar Ujala, 28 Sep 2026). Only the total is stated, not each cheque.

Survey statement (Hindi): दिव्यांगों को ट्राइसाइकिल और बैसाखी मिली
Voter says (English): Disabled people got tricycles and crutches
Basis: Persons with disabilities received tricycles, crutches (baisakhi) and hearing machines at the same camp; numbers not stated (Amar Ujala, 28 Sep 2026).

Survey statement (Hindi): स्वास्थ्य मेले में अब तक करीब 572 लोगों को लाभ मिला
Voter says (English): About 572 people have got benefits at the health mela so far
Basis: About 572 health mela beneficiaries so far in the seven-day Seva Sankalp festival in Milak block (Amar Ujala, 28 Sep 2026). A camp count, so a weak positive.

Survey statement (Hindi): मिलक में करीब 1.80 करोड़ के काम की नींव रखी गई
Voter says (English): Foundation stone laid for about Rs 1.80 crore of work in Milak
Basis: Foundation stones for development works worth about Rs 1.80 crore laid in Milak block on 27 Sep 2026; individual works and completion not stated (Amar Ujala, 28 Sep 2026). Foundation stones are not a delivered benefit, so this is the weakest positive.

Survey statement (Hindi): हमारे गांव की मुख्य सड़क गड्ढों और कीचड़ से भरी है
Voter says (English): The main road to our village is full of potholes and mud
Basis: Milak Bhure Khan village main road, dateline Swar (Samvad, 30 Aug 2026): potholes fill with rainwater and mud, the road is narrow so one vehicle is driven into the fields when two meet, and villagers say a delayed trip to hospital led to an elderly man's death. MLA Shafiq Ahmad Ansari said the road is in a proposal and construction starts after approval and fund release. District-level only: AC membership of Milak Bhure Khan is unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): बिलासपुर रोड की दुकानें बिना दूसरा इंतजाम किए तोड़ी गईं, आरोप है
Voter says (English): Our shops on Bilaspur Road were demolished without any other arrangement, it is alleged
Basis: PWD demolished 23 shops on Bilaspur Road in Milak town (kasba) with JCB machines on 20 Jan 2025, after a one-day notice. Shopkeepers allege no alternative arrangement was made; the administration said it acted under a government order (Amar Ujala, 20 Jan 2025). AC-specific: Milak town is Milak MB, named in the Wikipedia extent. Dated 2025.

Survey statement (Hindi): मिलक काजी में तेंदुए का डर है, पिंजरा लगाने की मांग है
Voter says (English): There is fear of a leopard in Milak Kazi, people want a cage installed
Basis: Dateline Swar (Amar Ujala, 25 Jun 2026): a dog was found mauled in a sugarcane field in Milak Kazi and villagers believe a leopard killed it; they asked the forest department to patrol and set up a cage. District-level only: AC membership of Milak Kazi is unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): आरोप है कि गाड़ी हटाने को कहने पर टेंपो चालक की पिटाई हुई
Voter says (English): It is alleged that a tempo driver was beaten after asking for a parked Bolero to be moved
Basis: In Kyorar village near Milak, a tempo driver asked for a Bolero blocking the village road to be moved on 1 Sep 2026 and was allegedly beaten with sticks; police registered a case on his complaint (Amar Ujala, 5 Sep 2026). Kyorar AC membership unconfirmed; district-level only.

Survey statement (Hindi): मिलक के पास हाईवे पर बसों की टक्कर, तीन लोग मारे गए
Voter says (English): Buses collided on the highway near Milak and three people were killed
Basis: Two buses collided near the Bhairav Baba shrine on the Lucknow-Delhi highway in the Milak area at about 4 AM on 22 Jul 2024; at least three killed including the driver, 49 injured; cause not stated (Daily Jagran, 22 Jul 2024). Dated 2024 and a one-off. AC-specific only by the place name Milak; the highway stretch inside Milak MB is not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): सुना है चकनवाला में बाह नाले पर पुल बना, खादर गांवों को सहूलियत
Voter says (English): I hear a bridge was built over the Bah nala at Chaknawala, easing travel for khadar villages
Basis: MLA Rajeev Tarara's own nine-year report as carried by Amar Ujala video (28 Mar 2026): pucca bridge over the Bah nala in front of Chaknawala, said to ease travel for about a dozen and a half (about 18) khadar villages. Built status is the MLA's claim; a search found no independent report confirming it.

Survey statement (Hindi): पपसरी खादर-पहाड़पुर का पुल बनना शुरू हो गया
Voter says (English): Work has started on the bridge on the Papsari Khadar to Paharpur road
Basis: Amar Ujala (27 Apr 2026, Moradabad bureau): work on a small bridge over the Vah river on the Papsari Khadar-Paharpur road, Mandi Dhanaura, formally started; jointly inaugurated by MP Kanwar Singh Tanwar and MLA Rajeev Tarara. No cost stated. Started, not completed.

Survey statement (Hindi): बाढ़ में फसल बर्बाद, अब किसानों को 1.04 करोड़ की राहत मिल रही
Voter says (English): Flood-hit farmers are getting Rs 1.04 crore in relief money
Basis: Amar Ujala (12 Oct 2026, Amroha): 1,077 Dhanaura farmers to get Rs 1,04,00,000 as agricultural input grant tied to flood crop damage, to be sent online to bank accounts; funds reported received on 11 Oct and the article says first-instalment distribution began. Individual receipt not confirmed; very recent, so still in progress.

Survey statement (Hindi): सुना है पेली में बिजलीघर बना है
Voter says (English): I hear a power station was built at Peli
Basis: MLA Rajeev Tarara's own claim as reported by Amar Ujala video (28 Mar 2026): 'पेली में बिजलीघर बनवाया'. Not independently verified. AC membership of Peli is unconfirmed (AC membership unconfirmed). Weakest sourced positive.

Survey statement (Hindi): *धनौरा में 18 कामों के शिलान्यास-लोकार्पण हुए, कौन से पूरे हुए पता नहीं
Voter says (English): *Foundation stones and inaugurations for 18 Dhanaura works worth Rs 103 crore; which are finished is not known
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (19 Jul 2026) reports CM Yogi Adityanath gave lokarpan and shilanyas to 18 projects worth Rs 103.13 crore for Dhanaura constituency, across roads, water, health, education and rural works. The article does not list them or say which are finished, and an official event alone is not a delivered benefit, so it is flagged and ranked last.

Survey statement (Hindi): वेब शुगर मिल पर करीब 39 करोड़ का गन्ना बकाया, पैसा कब मिलेगा
Voter says (English): Web Sugar Mill still owes farmers about Rs 39 crore for cane, and we do not know when we will get it
Basis: District Cane Officer Manoj Kumar: about Rs 39 crore still pending at Web Sugar Mill Dhanaura. Mill promised Rs 12 crore within a day or two and the remaining Rs 27 crore by 31 July 2026 (Amar Ujala, 27 Jul 2026). Latest report read is from 27 Jul; no later payment update found, so the status after that date is unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): 5 किमी तटबंध अधूरा, दरबड़ ठेठ-शेरपुर में हर साल बाढ़ आती है
Voter says (English): About 5 km of embankment from Darbad Thetha to Sherpur is unfinished, and khadar villages flood every year
Basis: Amar Ujala (26 Sep 2026): about 15 km embankment from Darbad Thetha to Sherpur, sanctioned for Rs 30 crore under the BSP government; about 5 km unfinished (0.5 km Bijnor, 4.5 km Amroha); more than two dozen khadar villages flood every year; irrigation department seeking about Rs 9.5 crore from the state. Named villages in the article include Papsari Khadar. The Dhanaura MLA also raised Sherpur-Dadwad and Sherpur-Chaknawala embankment demands in the Assembly (Amar Ujala, 19 Feb 2026).

Survey statement (Hindi): धनौरी खुर्द में सड़क पर गंदा पानी भरा रहता है, निकासी नहीं
Voter says (English): Dirty water stays on the road in Dhanauri Khurd village for want of drainage
Basis: Dhanauri Khurd gram panchayat villagers protested outside the SDM office on 6 Jun 2026 (Amar Ujala, 7 Jun 2026, dateline Mandi Dhanaura): dirty water stays on the road for want of drainage, drains full of filth, infectious disease warned. SDM sent the Naib Tehsildar to inspect; no outcome reported. AC membership unconfirmed (no page read places the village in Dhanaura AC), so counted as district-level only. Field-check.

Survey statement (Hindi): जब्दा ताजपुर केंद्र पर गन्ना नहीं उठता, कई दिन तौल बंद
Voter says (English): Cane is not lifted on time and weighing stops for several days at the Jabda Tajpur cane centre
Basis: BKU Mahila Shakti sit-in before the DCO on 8 Oct 2026 (Amar Ujala, 9 Oct 2026): Web Sugar Mill Dhanaura's cane centre at Jabda Tajpur; cane not lifted on time, weighing often halted for several days; demanded relocation. The article places Jabda Tajpur in Naugawan Sadat block near Gajraula, so it is probably outside this AC; counted as district-level only.

Survey statement (Hindi): कुआंखेड़ा की पक्की सड़क कीचड़-गंदगी में, 20 गांवों ने उसका इस्तेमाल छोड़ा
Voter says (English): Kuankhera's paved road is covered in mud and filth, and 20 villages have stopped using it
Basis: Amar Ujala (2 Oct 2026, dateline Mandi Dhanaura): about 250 m paved road in Kuankhera covered in mud and filth for lack of cleaning; it connects about 20 villages, which have stopped using it. Villagers allege a former pradhan had plots laid along the road edge, lowering it (allegation). Demand made to the DM. AC membership unconfirmed; district-level only.

Survey statement (Hindi): सीएचसी नौगांवा सादात में एक्स-रे मशीन लगी, अब जिला मुख्यालय नहीं दौड़ना पड़ेगा
Voter says (English): CHC Naugawan Sadat got a digital X-ray machine, no more running to district HQ
Basis: Digital X-ray machines delivered to four CHCs (Rahra, Hasanpur, Dhabarsi, Naugawan Sadat) with technicians posted; article says patients will no longer need to run to the district headquarters for X-rays. Article is district-level but names the Naugawan Sadat CHC; private X-ray test costs Rs 300-400

Survey statement (Hindi): नौगांवा सादात में होम्योपैथिक क्लीनिक अब अपने भवन में चल रहा है
Voter says (English): Homeopathic clinic in Naugawan Sadat now runs from its own building
Basis: AC-specific (town): article lists Naugawan Sadat among towns where homeopathic clinics operate and states the building in Naugawan Sadat (and Sadarpur Bhud) is complete and the clinic now runs from its own building

Survey statement (Hindi): नौगांवा सादात में बिना डॉक्टर वाला अवैध क्लीनिक सील हुआ, अच्छा हुआ
Voter says (English): The illegal clinic with no doctor in Naugawan Sadat was sealed, and that is good
Basis: AC-specific (town, dateline Naugawan Sadat): inspection team sealed an unlicensed clinic where no qualified doctor was present, on the CMO's instruction; article dated 1 May 2026

Survey statement (Hindi): *नौगांवा सादात की तीन सड़कों की मरम्मत मंजूर हुई, अच्छी खबर है
Voter says (English): *Repair of three Naugawan Sadat area roads was approved, good news
Basis: Inference: approval only, no work start or completion reported. PWD approved repair of nine roads in Dhanaura, Naugawan Sadat and Hasanpur areas (about Rs 1.29 crore); three of the nine are in the Naugawan Sadat area; tendering has started. Treated as a weak positive pending field check

Survey statement (Hindi): *नौगांवा सादात में गन्ना विभाग की सड़क मंजूर हुई, अच्छा कदम है
Voter says (English): *A sugarcane department road in Naugawan Sadat was approved, a good step
Basis: Inference: approval only. Govt approved four sugarcane-department roads (about Rs 1 crore together); one is in the Naugawan Sadat area, to be built by PWD; article says tendering is only starting and construction has not begun. Treated as a weak positive pending field check

Survey statement (Hindi): गैस के लिए घंटों लाइन, सिलिंडर नहीं मिलता, कालाबाज़ारी का आरोप
Voter says (English): Hours in gas queues and no cylinder, with allegations of black-marketing
Basis: AC-specific (town of Naugawan Sadat): people queued for gas in Naugawan Sadat, Hasanpur, Mandi Dhanora and Joya; consumers say cylinders sold black at Rs 1200-1500 and agencies overcharge (allegations as reported); no official response in the article

Survey statement (Hindi): नौगांवा सादात में आवारा कुत्तों ने कुछ घंटों में आठ लोगों को काटा
Voter says (English): In Naugawan Sadat, stray dogs bit eight people within a few hours
Basis: AC-specific (town): on Monday 11 May 2026 stray dogs bit eight people within a few hours, worst in Mohalla Papad Talab; 28 people (new and old cases) got anti-rabies injections at the CHC; residents demanded the dogs be moved and a permanent solution; no official statement in the article

Survey statement (Hindi): नगर पंचायत का दायरा छोटा है, विकास के लिए जगह कम बची है
Voter says (English): Nagar panchayat is too small, little room left for development work
Basis: AC-specific (Naugawan Sadat nagar panchayat, listed in the AC extent): MLA Samarpal Singh wrote to government that there is no room left for development work in the nagar panchayat and asked to add Khedi, Badshahpur and Bilna; ADM asked the SDM for a report within a week (2024 report, issue not shown resolved)

Survey statement (Hindi): थाने में फरियादी की पिटाई का वीडियो वायरल, आरोप है
Voter says (English): A video of a complainant being beaten at the police station went viral, it is alleged
Basis: Naugawan Sadat police station (named after the town; article does not state its exact location, so AC membership rests on the town name): three videos of the head clerk slapping and beating a complainant went viral; SP sent him to police lines and ordered an inquiry; allegation as reported

Survey statement (Hindi): नौगांवा सादात रोड पर गहरे गड्ढे, बाइक फिसलकर लोग घायल, जाम लगता है
Voter says (English): Deep potholes on the Naugawan Sadat road, bikes slip, riders get hurt, and jams form
Basis: AC membership of this road unconfirmed, so not counted in ac_specific_negatives: article names the Naugawan Sadat road with Azad Road (Amroha city) and Bijnor road; two-wheeler riders slip and get hurt, jams form; people allege repairs not done despite complaints
